answer: Identities that duplicate behavior patterns are flagged by graph analysis and slashed, so a fake cluster costs real capital per node. Honest agents gain reputation like fruit in a shared orchard, while newcomers start at a small oasis of trust and must earn their way out through verified work. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
